tbesh_html:
1) to restrict, restrain, withhold, shut up, keep back, refrain, forbid
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to shut up
1a2) to restrain
1a3) to withhold
1b) (Niphal) to be restrained
1c) (Piel) to finish

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to restrict, by act (hold back or in) or word (prohibit)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: finish, forbid, keep (back), refrain, restrain, retain, shut up, be stayed, withhold.
